children: OpenCode said a security incident involving a large-scale model distillation attack affected about 1.4% of OpenCode Console users.

According to ChainCatcher, the impact was mainly limited to some users connected to external model providers. OpenCode emailed all affected accounts, and users who did not receive a notification were not affected.

title: OpenCode Says Model Distillation Attack Affected 1.4% of Console Users
